reviewNotes: Vicefold is an unofficial fan companion for Grand Theft Auto VI (released Nov 19, 2026). All text in the app is written by us from public facts (mission names, character names, cheat codes); no game art, logos or screenshots are included, and the map is our own drawing. The app clearly states it is not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive (Settings > About, Home screen footer, description). No account is needed. Optional PlayStation play time (Pro): the user signs in on Sony's own page in a web view; we never see the password, and only read the user's own game list and play time, stored on the device. Pro (one-time or subscription) unlocks map extras and sync; every guide is free. Music previews come from Apple's public iTunes Search API and link to Apple Music.
